text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Both the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2023-v1.11) and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) agree on the loss of 4.5 hectares of tree cover in 2023. The loss area is within the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 hectares and meets the corroboration rule. The forest type in the event area is planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda.
